'''Tosser Three''' was a [[Stassian]] [[Athlete/Legends|athlete]] who played the game of [[ringers]]. They were questioned by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Valon Rizz]] who was looking into [[Reye Sedeya]]'s lucky [[Gambling/Legends|winning streak]].
